desc:
Start in your bedroom in 1995 and build the biggest PC company in the world.

🎨 DESIGN every PC: case, processor, graphics, memory, cooling, colours and RGB lighting. Set the price and hand it to your team.

🏗️ BUILD your office your way: walls, floors, desks, labs and decor, from a bedroom to a Headquarters.

👥 HIRE a team. Your Roblox friends show up as candidates with their real avatars.

🔬 RESEARCH new tech year by year and unlock laptops.

🚀 LAUNCH, watch the benchmark, read the reviews and see sales come in live. Beat rivals and set world records.

🏆 COMPETE on global leaderboards, then go public and start again with permanent perks.

✅ 30 goals with cash rewards
✅ 5 save slots
✅ Plays on phone, tablet and PC
✅ Saves automatically

👍 Like and favourite to follow updates!
